(Currently Amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain [[strikethrough]] to create a path[[/strikethrough]] __between tissue layers within the brain__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

4. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __into the brain__.

5. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device __in a manner that allows it to displace tissue layers__ within the brain. 

7. (Currently Amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue __between tissue layers__ to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

10. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device __specifically designed for tissue displacement__ between tissue layers.
